capabilities: Narrow a note or folder to phone width with 360/390/412px presets
Style editing and reader views separately with 13 background themes
Apply Korean and custom font presets with size, line height and paragraph spacing
Show a phone frame with a status bar (time, title, battery, progress)
Auto-apply phone mode to every note in a registered folder
disambiguation: Not a mobile app or sync tool; it only renders a note at phone width inside the current Obsidian window.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; settings UI is in Korean only.
problem: Desktop editors wrap lines differently than phone reading apps, so web novel authors can't see the reader's actual line breaks while writing.

relations.evidence: link colouring can follow that plugin's "disable link colour" setting

summary: Phone-width writing and reading view for web novels, with separate writing/reader themes, fonts and an optional phone frame.
